title: InstallRate leaderboard: what Claude, GPT and Gemini install
excerpt: Which devtools and APIs AI coding agents actually install, in 20 categories, measured from real build prompts.
content_html:

Findings

  • Supabase is mentioned, never installed: the Postgres host AI agents pick
  • Drizzle vs Prisma: which ORM Claude, GPT and Gemini install
  • Sentry and Playwright: the only tools AI agents install every time
  • Which email API do AI agents install? Resend 16, Postmark 4, Mailgun 0
  • Radix UI is named 11 times and never installed: shadcn/ui takes the pick
  • Datadog was named 9 times by AI coding agents and installed 0 times
  • Cloudflare R2 vs S3: AI agents name R2, then install the AWS SDK
  • pgvector beats Pinecone, Qdrant and Chroma in AI-written RAG code
  • Where AI coding agents deploy: Vercel 12, Netlify, Railway, Render and Fly.io 0

Share = the product the answer installed first, out of all answers in that category. Samples are small (about 10 answers per model per category), so read the bands on each category page. How we measure.
